title: Minimax Estimation of Causal Sinkhorn Divergence under Third-Moment Outcome Conditions
banked_reason: D0.5 terminal below field floor: sound citation-verified unmatched n^-1/3 vs n^-1/3(log n)^(1/3) bracket, achieved incremental, score ceiling 5 < 7.4, salvageable=false; independent gate confirms no bounded scoped repair.
gap_reasons: The current core delivers a usable explicit n^{-1/3} lower versus n^{-1/3}(1+log n)^{1/3} upper bracket, not the promised matching sharp risk and honest-length frontier; the unresolved logarithmic gap must be closed or the contribution recast as the bracket theorem.

The delivered result brackets both minimax quantities between n^(-1/3) and n^(-1/3)(1+log n)^(1/3), with finite-sample honest upper witnesses. Its upper analysis combines established [shadow stability](https://www.math.columbia.edu/~mnutz/docs/quantStability.pdf) and [dyadic empirical Wasserstein control](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1312.2128) through moment allocation and Hölder inequalities; the resulting contribution is a narrow moment-class extension, without a new centered-value localization theorem. The optimized two-point sandwich controls one population family and supplies no arbitrary-cardinality empirical cancellation estimate or logarithmic converse. The TL;DR and justification accurately disclose this scope, so there is no stale claim of an established sharp frontier. The projected paper score is constrained by that modest methodological increment and by an exhaustive solver with extremely conservative interval constants, which does not establish the advertised prospective usefulness for STE implementation or welfare analysis. proof_attempt_summary: D0 audited the entropy shadow/dyadic baseline, exact shell ledger, strengthened rare-event witness, raw empirical solver and optimized two-point diagnostic, but did not close the arbitrary-cardinality optimizer-sensitive localization or matched frontier. The sound delivered risk and honest-length bracket has lower order n^(-1/3) and upper order n^(-1/3)(1+log n)^(1/3); citations passed with primary-source attestations. D0.5 graded it incremental below the field floor, and an independent terminal gate confirmed a downgraded retry/solver_blocked disposition; no F-stage or Lean formalization occurred.
tldr: The fixed-entropy causal Sinkhorn divergence compares the two identified counterfactual marginal laws in the fair-label iid experiment. On the full bivariate third-moment class, the proved absolute-risk and honest connected-interval length bracket has lower order \(n^{-1/3}\) and achieved upper order \(n^{-1/3}(1+\log n)^{1/3}\). A total finite original-record procedure evaluates raw empirical cross and self values without clipping outcomes and supplies a connected interval with at least \(0.90\) coverage at every finite sample size. The proved optimized two-point diagnostic is of order \(\delta^2\), despite a binary-entropy discrepancy for prescribed feasible plans. This population diagnostic does not control arbitrary-cardinality adjacent-shell empirical values, same-sample self fluctuations, or the shell sum. Both joint-value localization and the sharp frontier, including any necessary logarithm, remain open.
gap: \cite{AgarwalLuedtke2026STE} treats the same causal functional with bounded outcomes. \cite{GroppeHundrieser2024LCA} controls empirical entropic values on compact supports and in a partially unbounded subGaussian setting. Neither supplies uniform magnitude precision over the displayed third-moment class.
fill: The main question binds the unchanged original-record decision problem and a total finite observable attaining procedure. A joint value certificate must retain shell probabilities and all product-reference entropy changes, with no uniform inverse bound imposed. The competing composite-testing route keeps the sharp answer open.
